column2:
wait(v./n.)等待、等候
waiter(n.)服務生
waitress(n.)女服務生
wait for 等待
can't wait 迫不及待
Please wait for me at the gate.
(請在門口等我。)
I can't wait to see you.
(我等不及要見到你。)

wake(v.)醒來、叫醒
awake(adj.)醒著的
waken(v.)喚醒
wake up 醒來、叫醒
wake-up call 叫醒服務、警鐘
I wake up at six every morning.
(我每天早上六點起床。)
Please wake me up at seven.
(請在七點叫醒我。)

walk(v./n.)走路、散步、遛(狗)
walker(n.)步行者
take a walk 散步
walk the dog 遛狗
Let's take a walk in the park.
(我們去公園散步吧。)
I walk to school every day.
(我每天走路上學。)

wall(n.)牆壁、城牆
(無詞性變化)
the Great Wall 萬里長城
on the wall 在牆上
There is a clock on the wall.
(牆上有一個時鐘。)
We visited the Great Wall in China.
(我們參觀了中國的萬里長城。)

want(v./n.)想要、需要、缺乏
wanted(adj.)被通緝的、受歡迎的
want to 想要做
for want of 因缺乏
I want to be a doctor.
(我想成為醫生。)
Do you want some cake?
(你想吃點蛋糕嗎？)

warm(adj./v.)溫暖的、熱情的、使暖和
warmth(n.)溫暖
warmly(adv.)溫暖地、熱情地
warm up 暖身、加熱
warm welcome 熱烈歡迎
It is warm and sunny today.
(今天溫暖又晴朗。)
We always warm up before running.
(我們跑步前總會先暖身。)

watch(v./n.)觀看、注意、手錶
(無詞性變化)
watch TV 看電視
watch out 小心
Watch out! A car is coming.
(小心！有車子來了。)
I got a new watch for my birthday.
(我生日時收到一支新手錶。)

water(n./v.)水、澆水
watery(adj.)水分多的
drinking water 飲用水
water the plants 澆花
Drink more water on hot days.
(天氣熱時要多喝水。)
I water the plants every morning.
(我每天早上澆花。)

wave(n./v.)波浪、揮手、揮動
wavy(adj.)波浪狀的
wave goodbye 揮手道別
heat wave 熱浪
She waved goodbye to her friends.
(她向朋友們揮手道別。)
The big waves hit the beach.
(大浪拍打著海灘。)

way(n.)路、方法、方式、方向
(無詞性變化)
by the way 順帶一提
on the way 在路上
Is this the way to the station?
(這是往車站的路嗎？)
By the way, where is your sister?
(順便問一下，你姊姊在哪裡？)

we(pron.)我們
us(pron.)我們(受格)
our(pron.)我們的
ours(pron.)我們的(東西)、ourselves(pron.)我們自己
we all 我們大家
by ourselves 我們自己、獨自
We are in the same class.
(我們同班。)
We cleaned the classroom by ourselves.
(我們自己打掃了教室。)

weak(adj.)虛弱的、弱的、不擅長的
weakness(n.)弱點
weaken(v.)削弱
weak point 弱點
feel weak 感到虛弱
I feel weak after being sick.
(生病後我覺得很虛弱。)
Math is my weak subject.
(數學是我不擅長的科目。)

wear(v.)穿、戴、磨損
(無詞性變化)
wear glasses 戴眼鏡
wear out 磨損、使疲憊
She wears glasses in class.
(她上課時戴眼鏡。)
Wear a jacket. It's cold outside.
(穿件外套，外面很冷。)

weather(n./v.)天氣、安然度過
(無詞性變化)
weather forecast 天氣預報
bad weather 惡劣天氣
What's the weather like today?
(今天天氣如何？)
The weather forecast says it will rain.
(天氣預報說會下雨。)

week(n.)週、星期
weekly(adj./adv.)每週的、每週一次
last week 上週
once a week 一週一次
I visit my grandma once a week.
(我一週去探望奶奶一次。)
We had a test last week.
(我們上週考了一次試。)

weekend(n./v.)週末、度週末
(無詞性變化)
on weekends 在週末
weekend trip 週末旅行
What do you do on weekends?
(你週末都做些什麼？)
We went on a weekend trip to Yilan.
(我們去宜蘭週末旅行。)

welcome(v./adj./n.)歡迎、受歡迎的
(無詞性變化)
you're welcome 不客氣
welcome party 歡迎會
Welcome to our school!
(歡迎來到我們學校！)
Thank you. You're welcome.
(謝謝你。不客氣。)

well(adv./adj./n.)好地、健康的、井
(無詞性變化)
as well 也
well done 做得好
She sings very well.
(她唱歌唱得很好。)
I don't feel well today.
(我今天覺得不太舒服。)

west(n./adj./adv.)西方、西方的、向西
western(adj.)西方的、西部的
westward(adv.)向西
the West 西方國家
west coast 西岸
The sun sets in the west.
(太陽從西邊落下。)
They drove west to the beach.
(他們往西開車去海邊。)

wet(adj./v.)濕的、下雨的、弄濕
(無詞性變化)
get wet 弄濕、淋濕
wet paint 油漆未乾
I got wet in the rain.
(我被雨淋濕了。)
Don't touch it. The paint is still wet.
(別碰，油漆還沒乾。)

what(pron./adj.)什麼、什麼樣的
whatever(pron./adj.)無論什麼
what about ……怎麼樣
what time 幾點
What is your favorite food?
(你最喜歡的食物是什麼？)
What time is it now?
(現在幾點？)

when(adv./conj./pron.)何時、當……時
whenever(conj.)每當、無論何時
since when 從何時起
when to 何時該
When is your birthday?
(你的生日是什麼時候？)
I was sleeping when you called.
(你打電話來的時候我正在睡覺。)

where(conj./adv./pron./n.)哪裡、在……的地方
wherever(conj.)無論哪裡
where to 去哪裡
from where 從哪裡
Where do you live?
(你住在哪裡？)
This is the house where I grew up.
(這是我長大的房子。)

whether(conj.)是否、不論
(無詞性變化)
whether or not 是否、不論是否
whether to 是否要
I don't know whether he will come.
(我不知道他是否會來。)
We will go whether it rains or not.
(不論下不下雨，我們都會去。)

which(pron./adj.)哪一個、哪一些
whichever(pron./adj.)無論哪一個
which one 哪一個
which way 哪條路、哪個方向
Which one do you like better?
(你比較喜歡哪一個？)
Which bus goes to the zoo?
(哪一班公車到動物園？)

while(conj./n./v.)當……時、然而、一會兒、消磨
(無詞性變化)
for a while 一會兒
once in a while 偶爾
Please wait for a while.
(請稍等一會兒。)
He listens to music while he studies.
(他一邊讀書一邊聽音樂。)

white(adj./n.)白色的、白色
whiten(v.)使變白
white shirt 白襯衫
black and white 黑白的
He is wearing a white shirt today.
(他今天穿著白襯衫。)
Snow is white and cold.
(雪又白又冷。)

who(pron.)誰、……的人
whom(pron.)誰(受格)
whoever(pron.)無論是誰
who else 還有誰
who knows 誰知道
Who is that girl?
(那個女孩是誰？)
The man who lives next door is a doctor.
(住在隔壁的那位男士是醫生。)

whose(pron.)誰的、那個人的
(無詞性變化)
whose turn 輪到誰
whose fault 誰的錯
Whose bag is this?
(這是誰的包包？)
I have a friend whose father is a pilot.
(我有個朋友，他的爸爸是機師。)

why(adv./n.)為什麼、原因
(無詞性變化)
why not 為什麼不、好啊
that's why 那就是為什麼
Why are you late today?
(你今天為什麼遲到？)
Let's go to the movies. Why not?
(我們去看電影吧。好啊！)

wide(adj./adv.)寬的、廣泛的、完全地
width(n.)寬度
widely(adv.)廣泛地
widen(v.)使變寬
wide open 大開的
wide range 廣泛的範圍
This river is very wide.
(這條河非常寬。)
The door was wide open.
(門大大地敞開著。)

wife(n.)妻子、太太
(無詞性變化)
husband and wife 夫妻
his wife 他的太太
He lives with his wife and two kids.
(他和太太及兩個孩子住在一起。)
His wife is a teacher.
(他的太太是一位老師。)

will(aux./n.)將會、願意、意志、遺囑
willing(adj.)願意的
willingness(n.)意願
free will 自由意志
against one's will 違背某人的意願
I will call you tomorrow.
(我明天會打電話給你。)
She has a strong will to win.
(她有強烈的求勝意志。)

win(v./n.)贏、獲勝、贏得、勝利
winner(n.)贏家、優勝者
win a prize 得獎
win the game 贏得比賽
Our team won the game yesterday.
(我們隊昨天贏了比賽。)
She won first prize in the contest.
(她在比賽中得了第一名。)

wind(n./v.)風、蜿蜒、上發條
windy(adj.)多風的
strong wind 強風
wind up 結束、上發條
The wind is very strong today.
(今天風很大。)
The road winds up the mountain.
(這條路蜿蜒上山。)

window(n.)窗戶、視窗
(無詞性變化)
open the window 開窗
window seat 靠窗座位
Please close the window. It's cold.
(請關窗，好冷。)
I'd like a window seat, please.
(我想要靠窗的座位，謝謝。)

wise(adj.)聰明的、有智慧的、明智的
wisdom(n.)智慧
wisely(adv.)明智地
wise choice 明智的選擇
wise man 智者
It was a wise choice to bring an umbrella.
(帶傘是個明智的選擇。)
My grandfather is a wise old man.
(我爺爺是一位有智慧的老人。)

wish(v./n.)希望、祝福、願望
(無詞性變化)
make a wish 許願
best wishes 最誠摯的祝福
Close your eyes and make a wish.
(閉上眼睛許個願吧。)
I wish you a happy birthday.
(祝你生日快樂。)

with(prep.)和……一起、用、帶有
(無詞性變化)
with care 小心地
agree with 同意
I went shopping with my mom.
(我和媽媽一起去購物。)
She cut the paper with scissors.
(她用剪刀剪紙。)

without(prep./adv.)沒有、不、在外面
(無詞性變化)
without doubt 毫無疑問
do without 沒有……也行
I can't live without music.
(沒有音樂我活不下去。)
He left without saying goodbye.
(他沒說再見就離開了。)

woman(n.)女人、婦女
women(n.)女人(複數)
young woman 年輕女子
women's rights 女權
The woman in red is my aunt.
(穿紅衣服的那位女士是我阿姨。)
Many women work as engineers today.
(現今有許多女性擔任工程師。)

wonderful(adj.)極好的、精彩的
wonder(n./v.)奇蹟、驚奇、想知道
wonderfully(adv.)極好地
wonderful time 美好時光
wonderful idea 很棒的主意
We had a wonderful time at the beach.
(我們在海邊度過了美好時光。)
That's a wonderful idea!
(那真是個很棒的主意！)

word(n.)字、單字、話、諾言
wordy(adj.)冗長的
in other words 換句話說
keep one's word 遵守諾言
What does this word mean?
(這個字是什麼意思？)
He always keeps his word.
(他總是信守承諾。)

work(n./v.)工作、作品、運作、有效
worker(n.)工人
workable(adj.)可行的
work hard 努力工作
go to work 去上班
My dad goes to work by bus.
(我爸爸搭公車上班。)
This old phone doesn't work anymore.
(這支舊手機已經不能用了。)

worker(n.)工人、工作者
work(n./v.)工作
hard worker 工作勤奮的人
office worker 上班族
He is a hard worker.
(他是個工作勤奮的人。)
The workers are building a new bridge.
(工人們正在蓋一座新橋。)

world(n.)世界、領域
worldwide(adj./adv.)全世界的、在世界各地
around the world 世界各地
world record 世界紀錄
I want to travel around the world.
(我想環遊世界。)
He broke the world record.
(他打破了世界紀錄。)

worry(v./n.)擔心、煩惱
worried(adj.)擔心的
worrying(adj.)令人擔憂的
worry about 擔心
don't worry 別擔心
Don't worry. Everything will be fine.
(別擔心，一切都會沒事的。)
My mom worries about my health.
(我媽媽擔心我的健康。)

write(v.)寫、寫作、寫信
writer(n.)作家
writing(n.)寫作、筆跡
write down 寫下
write a letter 寫信
Please write down your name here.
(請在這裡寫下你的名字。)
I write in my diary every night.
(我每天晚上寫日記。)

writer(n.)作家、作者
write(v.)寫
writing(n.)寫作
famous writer 知名作家
writer's block 寫作瓶頸
She wants to be a writer.
(她想成為一位作家。)
The writer signed my book.
(那位作家在我的書上簽名。)

wrong(adj./adv./n./v.)錯誤的、不對勁的、錯誤、冤枉
wrongly(adv.)錯誤地
go wrong 出錯
what's wrong 怎麼了
What's wrong with you?
(你怎麼了？)
Sorry, I took the wrong bus.
(抱歉，我搭錯公車了。)

yard(n.)院子、碼(長度單位)
(無詞性變化)
back yard 後院
school yard 校園操場
The kids are playing in the yard.
(孩子們正在院子裡玩。)
We have a small garden in the back yard.
(我們家後院有個小花園。)

year(n.)年、年紀、年度
yearly(adj./adv.)每年的、每年一次
last year 去年
all year round 一整年
I started high school this year.
(我今年開始讀高中。)
It is warm here all year round.
(這裡一整年都很溫暖。)

yellow(adj./n./v.)黃色的、黃色、變黃
yellowish(adj.)帶黃色的
yellow card 黃牌
turn yellow 變黃
The leaves turn yellow in fall.
(葉子在秋天變黃。)
She has a yellow umbrella.
(她有一把黃色的雨傘。)

yes(adv./n.)是、對、好
yeah(adv.)是、對(口語)
say yes 答應
yes or no 是或不是
Yes, I'd love to come.
(好，我很樂意來。)
Yeah, that sounds great.
(對啊，聽起來很棒。)

yesterday(adv./n.)昨天
(無詞性變化)
the day before yesterday 前天
yesterday morning 昨天早上
I saw a movie yesterday.
(我昨天看了一部電影。)
It rained hard yesterday morning.
(昨天早上下了大雨。)

yet(adv./conj.)還(沒)、已經、然而
(無詞性變化)
not yet 還沒
as yet 到目前為止
Have you finished your homework yet?
(你寫完功課了嗎？)
He is young, yet he is very wise.
(他很年輕，卻很有智慧。)

you(pron.)你、你們
your(pron.)你的、你們的
yours(pron.)你的(東西)、你們的(東西)
yourself(pron.)你自己、yourselves(pron.)你們自己
help yourself 自己來、別客氣
yours truly 敬上
Help yourself to some cookies.
(請自己拿些餅乾吃。)
Is this pen yours?
(這支筆是你的嗎？)

young(adj./n.)年輕的、幼小的、幼崽
youth(n.)青春、年輕人
youngster(n.)年輕人、小孩
young people 年輕人
the young 年輕人(總稱)、幼崽
My mom looks very young.
(我媽媽看起來很年輕。)
The bird is feeding its young.
(那隻鳥正在餵牠的雛鳥。)

zero(n.)零、零度
(無詞性變化)
below zero 零度以下
zero waste 零浪費
It is below zero outside.
(外面低於零度。)
He got zero on the quiz.
(他小考得了零分。)

zoo(n.)動物園
(無詞性變化)
go to the zoo 去動物園
zoo keeper 動物園管理員
We saw pandas at the zoo.
(我們在動物園看到大貓熊。)
Let's go to the zoo this Sunday.
(這個星期天我們去動物園吧。)
